title: Compliance Manual — Missed-Entry Penalty on the Count of a Restructured Payment Arrangement
content:
Payment Arrangements restructures carry a missed-entry penalty: installments taken off the restructured count according to the plan's missed entries recorded in the last twelve months.

## Clause

The missed-entry penalty follows the plan's missed entries recorded in the last twelve months: 2 or more take away 4 installments, one takes away 2, and none takes away none.

The missed entries are those on the plan's installment history, placed in the period by the date each was recorded as missed. Periods of twelve months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Table

| Missed entries recorded in the last 12 months | Installments taken away |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 4 |
| 3 or more | 4 |

## Hypothetical records

- One missed entry recorded three months ago, none other: 2 installments taken away.
- Missed entries recorded three months ago and eleven months ago: 4.
- A missed entry recorded thirteen months ago and none since: none.
